page_title: LEC 0-1 ROM | Lecce v AS Roma 29/03/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+6' Claudio Ranieri is stunned as referee Gianluca Manganiello shows him a yellow card. What was that for?
90+6' Manu Kone (AS Roma) commits a foul during an attacking move.

90+5' Eldor Shomurodov (AS Roma) produced a promising shot low towards the middle of the goal after his wonderful solo run, but Wladimiro Falcone thwarted him with a fabulous save and the score remains the same.

90+4' Tommaso Baldanzi (AS Roma) sends a quick through ball into space for his teammate who is lurking close to the offside line, but one of the defenders intercepts and clears the danger. It's a throw-in for AS Roma.
90+2' Gianluca Manganiello blows his whistle and signals a foul after Bryan Cristante (AS Roma) brought his opponent down. Lecce have a free kick.
90+2' Manu Kone (AS Roma) commits a foul and Gianluca Manganiello immediately signals a free kick.
90+1' Antonino Gallo (Lecce) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.

90+1' Medon Berisha (Lecce) received a pass out of defence and immediately attempted a long-range shot, but a defender bravely blocked the effort. Lecce have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
90' The fourth official shows 6 min. of added time.

90' Konan Ndri (Lecce) shows off his amazing technique to get to the edge of the box by himself. He pulls the trigger but sends the ball miles of the left post. Nice run, but poor finish! The ball goes out of play and AS Roma will have a goal kick.

89' Eldor Shomurodov (AS Roma) homes in on a magnificent reverse pass from Angelino and strikes a crisp shot goalwards that just misses the left post. The ball goes out of play and Lecce will have a goal kick.
85' Lameck Banda (Lecce) latches on to an accurate pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a strong shot towards goal, but his effort is denied by the well positioned keeper.
84' Substitution. Ylber Ramadani leaves the pitch and is replaced by Ante Rebic (Lecce).
84' Substitution. Niccolo Pisilli (AS Roma) in, Alexis Saelemaekers out.
84' Claudio Ranieri decides to make a substitution. Artem Dovbyk will be replaced by Stephan El Shaarawy (AS Roma).
83' A pass into the box finds Artem Dovbyk (AS Roma) unmarked. He carefully places a shot towards the middle of the goal, but a brilliant last-ditch save by Wladimiro Falcone denies him.

80' 0 - 1 Artem Dovbyk (AS Roma) finishes his beautiful individual effort with a superb strike from inside the box. Wladimiro Falcone is just a bystander as the ball flies into bottom right corner. The score is 0:1.
79' Medon Berisha (Lecce) picks up a sweet pass and fires one in from distance towards the bottom right corner, but Mile Svilar is alert and makes a decent save.
78' Alexis Saelemaekers (AS Roma) is shown the yellow card for talking out of turn to the referee. It could have been worse!
77' Alexis Saelemaekers (AS Roma) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play. The ball goes out of play and Lecce will have a goal kick.
75' Tommaso Baldanzi (AS Roma) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.

74' Ylber Ramadani (Lecce) finds some space on the edge of the box after some nice individual play and curls a shot in on goal, but the ball flies just over the bar. The ball goes out of play and AS Roma will have a goal kick.
72' Substitution. Matias Soule makes his way off the pitch and Eldor Shomurodov (AS Roma) comes on as his replacement.
72' Claudio Ranieri has decided to make a change. Tommaso Baldanzi (AS Roma) replaces Lorenzo Pellegrini.
72' The referee allows time for a substitution. Thorir Johann Helgason will be replaced by Medon Berisha (Lecce).
72' A substitution has been made. Lassana Coulibaly goes off and Mohamed Kaba (Lecce) comes on.
71' The goal by AS Roma won't count as it has been disallowed due to offside on the advice of the video assistant referee!
68' Wait! Referee Gianluca Manganiello immediately makes the VAR signal, most likely to see if there was an offside in the build-up play.
68' The assistant referee raises his flag and the referee blows his whistle. Gianluca Mancini (AS Roma) puts the ball into the net, but he is flagged for offside.
67' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
67' Artem Dovbyk (AS Roma) strikes a first-time shot towards the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper denies him with an excellent save.
66' Lameck Banda (Lecce) tries to play a through ball from just inside the box to Thorir Johann Helgason, but one of the defending players is alert to the danger and makes a timely interception.

66' Wladimiro Falcone makes a brilliant save! Matias Soule (AS Roma) easily weaves through the defence and unleashes a shot from just outside of the box. His effort goes towards the middle of the goal but is saved by the keeper!
65' Konan Ndri (Lecce) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball.

63' Artem Dovbyk (AS Roma) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Gianluca Manganiello who sees an offensive foul. There is a free kick near the sideline to Lecce.
62' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) dribbles into the box, but Wladimiro Falcone is quick enough to come off his line and stop him.

61' Lameck Banda (Lecce) connects with the resulting free kick on the edge of the box, but can't find the target as his effort goes high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for AS Roma.

59' Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) probably spotted the goalkeeper off his line, but his long-range effort flew just a few inches wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and AS Roma will have a goal kick.
58' Here is a change. Santiago Pierotti is going off and Marco Giampaolo gives the last tactical orders to Lameck Banda (Lecce).
58' Today's match ends for Jesper Karlsson who will be replaced by Konan Ndri (Lecce).

57' Thorir Johann Helgason (Lecce) shows too much aggression during an attacking move and ends up fouling his opponent. It's a free kick to AS Roma, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.

56' Manu Kone (AS Roma) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Gianluca Manganiello stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning. Lecce are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
55' AS Roma keep the ball and are displaying some tiki-taka style passing at the moment.
54' Jesper Karlsson (Lecce) makes it easy for the referee to show him a yellow card.

51' Frederic Guilbert (Lecce) decides to take on the shot from mid-range after a rebound, but he fails to connect properly with the ball and the effort sails harmlessly wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and AS Roma will have a goal kick.
51' Thorir Johann Helgason (Lecce) will deliver the corner kick.
51' Santiago Pierotti (Lecce) fires the ball at goal from inside the area, but it's well blocked. Lecce will take a corner kick.
50' Lecce take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
49' Federico Baschirotto (Lecce) attempts a long crossfield pass, but the defence does well to intercept the ball. Now Lecce have a corner.
47' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Gianluca Manganiello signals. Lecce are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
47' 2:1 - the latest stats for both teams in respect of shots on target.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+2' The match has reached half-time.
45+1' Evan Ndicka (AS Roma) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Lecce win a free kick.

45+1' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) receives a brilliant pass and wastes a big opportunity as his shot from inside the penalty area flies just over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Lecce will have a goal kick.
45' We will have 1 min. of added time.
45' A cross is whipped into the box by Angelino (AS Roma) and Artem Dovbyk controls it well. He lines up the ball, but one of the defenders produces a timely intervention.
44' Jesper Karlsson (Lecce) receives a diagonal pass, bursts into the box and shoots towards the middle of the goal. Mile Svilar is well positioned, though, and it's a comfortable save.
43' Lassana Coulibaly (Lecce) commits a rough foul. Gianluca Manganiello stops the game and makes a call. A free kick has been awarded to AS Roma.

40' Frederic Guilbert finds Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) inside the box with a nice lofted pass, but he spanks the shot well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and AS Roma will have a goal kick.
40' Ylber Ramadani (Lecce) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The ball is behind the touchline and Lecce will take a throw-in.
37' Alexis Saelemaekers (AS Roma) sends a cross into the box, but Wladimiro Falcone comes off his line to gather the ball.

36' Antonino Gallo (Lecce) receives a precise low pass inside the box, controls the ball and releases it towards the left post. Unfortunately for him, Mile Svilar makes a great save to stop his effort.
35' Manu Kone (AS Roma) tries his luck with and strikes the ball towards goal from long-range, but it is blocked by one of the defenders.
34' Gianluca Mancini (AS Roma) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
32' Mats Hummels (AS Roma) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent. It's a free kick to Lecce in a dangerous position.
31' AS Roma players are exchanging short passes with one another, waiting for the right moment to beat the opposition's defence.
29' Evan Ndicka (AS Roma) tries to find Angelino, but he puts too much power on the pass.
28' The foul by Thorir Johann Helgason (Lecce) was seen by Gianluca Manganiello who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
27' What a big chance! Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) picks up an inch-perfect pass inside the box and skies the ball well over the bar. The ball goes out of play and AS Roma will have a goal kick.
27' The resulting corner from Thorir Johann Helgason (Lecce) comes to nothing.
26' Lassana Coulibaly (Lecce) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players. The ball goes out for a corner. Lecce can continue in their attacking effort.
23' Jesper Karlsson (Lecce) swings in the corner, but the goalkeeper does a brilliant job to intercept the effort.
22' Santiago Pierotti (Lecce) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Lecce.
22' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.

21' What a wasted opportunity by Manu Kone (AS Roma)! He unleashed a powerful low shot from the centre of the box, but Wladimiro Falcone makes a decent save to thwart him. The ball goes out of play. AS Roma are awarded a corner kick.
20' Good movement by Bryan Cristante (AS Roma), but he can't find any of his teammates as the cross is poor. The ball goes out of play and Lecce will have a goal kick.
20' The ball is out of play. AS Roma will have a chance to score from a corner.
19' Matias Soule (AS Roma) collects a pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
18' Mile Svilar leaps to collect the ball from the corner which was sent over by Jesper Karlsson (Lecce).
17' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Frederic Guilbert (Lecce). Corner kick. Lecce will have an opportunity.

15' Thorir Johann Helgason (Lecce) finds some space on the edge of the box after some nice individual play and curls a shot in on goal, but the ball flies just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for AS Roma.
15' Angelino (AS Roma) wastes a big opportunity! He controls the ball after a nice low pass and shoots from a promising distance. His poor effort goes miles wide of the right post.
13' AS Roma win a corner.
13' Artem Dovbyk (AS Roma) collects a brilliant pass inside the box and finds himself in a goal scoring opportunity. He takes a shot, but the effort is well blocked by one of the defending players.
12' Matias Soule (AS Roma) is unable to feed an accurate cross into the box. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lecce.
12' Alexis Saelemaekers (AS Roma) attempts to send a low pass into the box from the edge of the penalty area, but the opposition's defence knocks the ball to safety.
12' Frederic Guilbert (Lecce) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
10' Frederic Guilbert (Lecce) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
9' Angelino (AS Roma) has to stretch for the ball in the box and sends it just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Lecce will have a goal kick.
8' Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) runs through on goal, but he is flagged for offside by the linesman after failing to beat the offside trap.
7' Artem Dovbyk (AS Roma) gets on the end of a pass and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players.
6' Lecce hold possession of the ball and display neat passing from player to player. They are waiting for the right moment to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
5' Gianluca Mancini (AS Roma) sends a long ball across the pitch, but it misses its target.

3' Bryan Cristante (AS Roma) takes a snap shot from the edge of the box after a rebound, but his effort is a waste as it goes high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lecce.
3' A quickly taken corner by AS Roma.
3' AS Roma failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat. AS Roma force their opponents to concede a corner.
2' Alexis Saelemaekers (AS Roma) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. AS Roma have been awarded a corner kick.
1' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
1' The first half has just begun.
AS Roma will kick-off.
Gianluca Manganiello is introduced as the referee for today's match.
